build.help: build every package in the workspace (src, external, nested repos)

stack.help: bring the robot stack up, inspect it, tear it down (sim by default)

episode.help: record an episode against the running stack, end one, list them

dataset.help: manage catalog membership or process and verify recorded episodes

dataset.catalog.show.result: catalog_schema_version 1 detail with exact dataset_id and request_id
dataset.catalog.show.availability: processor must echo request_id on dataset detail; refusals use status

dataset.catalog.move.confirmation: explicit source, destination, and episode selection

project.help: list, create, rename, describe, delete, assign, or unassign projects (--host HOST)

process.help: inspect processing, prepare models, manage profiles, and queue annotation

process.provision.effect: download and verify pinned model weights
process.provision.confirmation: explicit model and processor selection; execution has separate approval
process.provision.result: provision state and exact request_id on /process/status
process.provision.availability: processor must configure provision_script and retain request_id

dataset-release.help: export, approve, build, verify, publish and deliver dataset releases on the processor

archive.help: inspect, preflight, reconcile, or install archive services

teleop.help: jog a robot arm through moveit servo

sim.help: launch a robot in a ros2_control sim backend

view-robot.help: render a robot urdf in foxglove studio

rig-health.help: pass/fail check of every recording fixture, stream, unit and link on a rig (--host <rig>)
